research.thaumaturgesdelight.base_culina: Only when you are full can you have the strength to do research!
research.thaumaturgesdelight.elemental_k:
Ever since I succeeded in infusing primal elements into tools, I have wondered whether one could be infused into a knife as well — absurd as that may sound...
As ever, let a thaumium tool be the first to go under the knife.

If my calculations hold — and I have not simply eaten myself into foolishness — this Knife of Butcher yields a few extra scraps of meat whenever it fells an animal. Nowhere near as grand as its siblings, perhaps, but a little more on the plate is still a little more, is it not?
And of course, an elemental property such as this could never belong to that one knife alone:§oCook Ding§r
When you kill an animal with a tool enchanted with this, it has a chance of dropping a few additional chunks of meat. Increasing the rank of this enchantment improves the chance.
§oRanks§r: 1-3
§oTarget§r: Knife
research.thaumaturgesdelight.unlock_culi: Although as a thaumaturge envoy, I know all kinds of secrets that ordinary people don't know, what I eat is very monotonous and not at all as good as those mortals. I think it's time for me to break through in this regard...
I think there are also various magic hidden in food, which ordinary people don't know.
